name: kit
description: Search, install, adapt and verify whole features (blocks) in your project, with a dry-run diff first; harvest and publish your own.

interface.shortDescription: Install whole, tested features into your project
interface.longDescription: A local MCP server with the Kitbash registry tools: search blocks, read a summary, install with a dry-run diff you review first, adapt the wiring, and prove it with the block's own tests. Also harvests and publishes your own blocks.
defaultPrompt: Use $kitbash-use to add email sign-in to this project.
Use $kitbash-use to find a block for rate limiting and install it.
Use $kitbash-harvest to turn this feature into a block.
Use $kitbash-publish to publish this block privately.
